gate.loadFailed: The profile state could not be read.

setup.title: Server profiles
setup.subtitle: The desktop app connects to a Keystone server. Each server is a separate profile.
setup.firstRun: Add a server address to get started.
setup.removeBody: The {{name}} profile is removed together with its sign-in and local data on this device.
setup.name: Profile name (optional)
setup.httpDebugNote: Development build: local addresses such as http://localhost:8000 are accepted only with KEYSTONE_DEV_ALLOW_HTTP=1.
setup.httpsNote: The address must start with https://.

login.title: Sign in
login.twoFactorBody: Enter the code from your authenticator app.
login.companyBody: Choose the company you work with on this device.
login.sessionFailed: The session could not be loaded. Please try again.

password.title: Change your password
password.body: Your account needs a password change. Passwords cannot be changed in the desktop app; change it in the web app and sign in again.
password.changedIt: I changed it, sign in again

security.devicesBody: Desktop devices signed in with your account.
security.webBody: Password, two-step verification and browser sessions are managed in the web app.

storeKey.title: Local data cannot be opened
storeKey.body: The local database key of the {{name}} profile is missing or has changed on this device. Nothing is deleted automatically.
storeKey.pendingNote: Because the local data cannot be read, unsent changes cannot be counted; a reset loses them. Server data is downloaded again.
storeKey.confirmLabel: Type the profile name to confirm: {{name}}

malformed.title: Profile record is damaged
malformed.body: The sign-in record of the {{name}} profile on this device could not be read.
malformed.resetBody: The sign-in and local data are deleted; the profile stays. You then sign in again.
malformed.removeBody: The profile is removed together with its sign-in and local data.

file.title: Profile file could not be read
file.body: The profiles.json file in the app data folder could not be read.
file.notOverwritten: The file was left as it is and not overwritten. Fix or move the file, then restart the app.

failed.title: The profile could not be opened

pending.title: Unsent work
pending.body: {{outbox}} unsent changes, {{conflicts}} open conflicts. If you continue, they are deleted.
pending.unknown: There are unsent changes or open conflicts. If you continue, they are deleted.

errors.INVALID_SERVER_URL: The server address is not valid.
errors.DESKTOP_UPDATE_REQUIRED: This server needs a newer version of the app.
errors.SYNC_SCHEMA_MISMATCH: The server's sync schema does not match this app.
errors.PROFILES_FILE_INVALID: The profile file could not be read or written; it was left untouched.
errors.PROFILE_BUSY: A request of the profile is still running. Try again shortly.
errors.EXTERNAL_OPEN_FAILED: The browser could not be opened.
errors.COMPANY_NOT_AVAILABLE: This company is not in your account.
errors.TOO_MANY_ATTEMPTS: Too many attempts. Try again shortly.
errors.STORE_KEY_INVALID: The local database key is not valid.
errors.unknown: The action could not be completed ({{code}}).
